== Summary ==
Players Committee legacy virtual-card slip PDF ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV'' (cover: official text as of 4 September 2009). This is the official <code>VirtualBlock6_1.pdf</code> that the Committee hosted at res.starwarsccg.org and that is cited on [[Virtual Block 6]].

* '''Date:''' 4 September 2009 (official text date on the cover)
* '''Pages:''' 14
